verdict.rationale: llama.cpp ships a `llama cli` command that lets developers start an interactive chat session directly from the terminal (llama-cpp-gh-1, llama-cpp-gh-4), and community reports confirm hands-on use of the CLI for interactive chat including multimodal '/image' commands (llama-cpp-comm-13). missing for 10: no explicit first-party doc snippet showing the interactive chat prompt/REPL flags or session persistence details, and only one independent corroboration source.
